subject.title: fix(tts): allow trusted local media in message_tool_only mode

question: Should `message_tool_only` allow internally trusted local media to bypass source suppression as stripped media-only content, or should this PR narrow the bypass to TTS-specific/tool-media provenance?
rationale: The code path appears correct for the proposed behavior, but the permanent delivery trust boundary affects private source-reply suppression and needs maintainer intent rather than a mechanical repair decision.

options.title: Accept trustedLocalMedia boundary
options.body: Land this PR with the current checks: media must be present, the payload must be internally trusted local media, text is stripped, and untrusted media remains suppressed.

options.title: Require TTS-only provenance
options.body: Ask for a small patch that keys the bypass to TTS/tool-media provenance instead of every trusted local media payload before merge.

options.title: Reject automatic media bypass
options.body: Keep the canonical bug open and require explicit message-tool delivery for media instead of any automatic bypass under `message_tool_only`.

recommendation.title: Accept trustedLocalMedia boundary
recommendation.body: Land this PR with the current checks: media must be present, the payload must be internally trusted local media, text is stripped, and untrusted media remains suppressed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged TTS/message-tool delivery history and repository routing make this the clearest owner for the suppression trust-boundary decision.
